original_test_intent: Run 250 WAT AC reboot cycles and verify every approved USB device/controller returns without errors; exact scenario and AC semantics unresolved.
original_method: Do not execute until corrected WAT AC/usbPoll scenario, package and AC fixture are approved; freeze connector/device serial/VID:PID/path/controller baseline, endpoints/secrets/readiness/event limits; run 250 fail-fast cycles with per-cycle USB inventory/speed/reset/errors plus BMC/OS evidence, then recover.
manual_activity: After resolution, operator supplies WAT/fixture, supervises 250 AC cycles and recovery.
safety_requirements: Abort on missing/fallback USB, reset storm, boot/BMC/power/thermal fault
agent_execution_scope: Must not choose scenario/drive AC cycles

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: AC reboot, usbPoll, USB-bus coverage and 250 cycles retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Per-cycle AC state plus connector/device/controller/speed/reset inventory ledger.

modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Final lsusb count or DC/warm cycles cannot replace per-cycle AC USB identity and speed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Devices may re-enumerate with changed paths or speed; serial/connector/controller mapping is needed.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines scenario tokens, AC dwell, allowed path changes and USB speed/reset tolerance.
